review: Finally, we can hit Jun with his own medicine. Kurokumo Heathcliff or KK Heathcliff for short is a unique ID with a revenge mechanic, where he will launch an unopposed attack against an enemy who damaged another ally. First, let’s talk about his unique mechanic which is his Passive. The Battle Ready Passive lets him gain 1 Slash Power Up if an ally from the Kurokumo faction dies (not stackable) and the Battle Ready status effect when 3 allies from the Kurokumo faction are defeated which gives 1 Slash Power Up, 3 Slash Damage Up, and +1 to Bleed infliction for both Potency and Count. The 1 Slash Power Up is nice especially in chain battles as you can just put a level 1 Kurokumo ID and let them die without much consequence and get a replacement. The Battle Ready status on the other hand can elevate KK Heathcliff’s value by a LOT but unless it is on purpose you won’t be seeing it much. Now
